molecular-dynamics: Use when trajectory RMSD or RMSF, PCA, conformational clustering, hydrogen-bond occupancy, Ramachandran plots or solvent-accessible surface analysis is requested. Analyses trajectories with a self-contained pure-numpy DCD and PDB parser plus built-in Kabsch-Sander alignment, SVD-PCA, hierarchical clustering, geometric hydrogen-bond detection, radius of gyration, inter-chain contacts and Shrake-Rupley SASA. 用于轨迹 RMSD/RMSF/PCA 与构象分析。
peptide-design: Use when analyzing or designing antimicrobial peptides — computing physicochemical properties, classifying peptides as antimicrobial or non-antimicrobial, deduplicating peptide libraries by clustering, and exporting FASTA or CSV. Computes molecular weight, isoelectric point, hydrophobicity and instability index; classifies peptides from GO terms and sequence features; clusters libraries with MMseqs2. 用于多肽性质计算、抗菌肽判别与去冗余。
pymol-structure-visualization: Use when analyzing inter-chain contacts in protein structures, identifying binding-interface hotspot residues, or building interaction networks and PyMOL visualization scripts. Computes residue-level contact geometry with a uniform-grid spatial index, classifies each contact into hydrogen bonds, salt bridges, hydrophobic, pi-pi stacking and cation-pi interactions, and exports CSV/JSON with Mermaid networks and PyMOL scripts. 用于链间接触分析、热点鉴定与 PyMOL 脚本。
protein-interactions: Use when interaction detection, hotspot ranking, PLIP report parsing, interaction network visualisation or AlphaFold confidence analysis is requested. Parses PLIP XML reports and AlphaFold packages with a standard-library XML parser; extracts residue-level salt bridges, hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic, pi-stacking, water bridges, halogen bonds and metal complexes, ranks hotspot residues, and emits Mermaid graphs plus PyMOL scripts. 用于相互作用解析与热点鉴定。
ml-peptide-generation: Use when designing peptides or protein fragments that should bind a target, generating a ranked candidate pool for a target sequence, or comparing how peptide length and top-k sampling affect candidate quality. Generates candidates with the PepMLM-650M masked language model, excluding illegal residues (X, B, Z); reports pseudo-perplexity per candidate, supports reproducible seeds, and needs no GPU. 用于多肽生成与候选排序。
ena-download: Use when fetching raw sequencing reads by SRA/ERR/DRR accession, retrieving FASTQ files for an RNA-seq project, or collecting run metadata and read counts. Downloads FASTQ from the ENA Portal API, resolving URLs and sizes from the structured API rather than scraping archive pages; supports batch accession lists, HTTP Range resume, and MD5 verification. 用于下载原始 reads 与运行元数据。
protein-docking-hdock: Use when running protein-protein complex structure prediction on the HDOCK server, checking the docking score of a submitted complex, or downloading top-ranked docked models. Submits jobs by plain HTTP rather than browser automation, accepting PDB files, PDB ID:ChainID references and FASTA sequences; retrieves Docking Score, Confidence Score, ligand RMSD and ranked models, records submissions to CSV, and polls for completion. 用于 HDOCK 对接与结果获取。
bio-database-fetch: Use when looking up compound properties by PubChem CID, retrieving CAS registry numbers, resolving NCBI Taxonomy IDs to species names, or collecting chemical and taxonomic reference data in bulk. Fetches molecular formula, weight, SMILES, InChI, InChIKey, IUPAC name, XLogP, TPSA and CAS numbers from PubChem PUG-REST, plus full taxonomy lineage from NCBI Taxonomy; batched with CSV/JSON export. 用于化合物性质、CAS 号与物种谱系查询。
alphafold-db: Use when fetching AlphaFold predicted structures, retrieving models by UniProt accession, or collecting AlphaFold confidence metrics (pLDDT). Downloads PDB/CIF models from the EBI AlphaFold Database API, resolving the current URL from the API instead of hard-coding a model version; supports batch accession lists, resumable downloads, pLDDT filtering, and content-type validation. 用于下载 AlphaFold 结构与 pLDDT。
protein-structure: Use when secondary structure assignment, radius of gyration, shape analysis, DSSP, PDB parsing or protein structure annotation is requested. Parses ATOM/HETATM records with a dependency-free pure-Python parser, computes radius of gyration, gyration tensor and dipole moments, assigns secondary structure via DSSP or a built-in Kabsch-Sander implementation, and optionally retrieves UniProt metadata. 用于 PDB 解析与二级结构指派。
paper-fulltext-extract: Use when extracting structured full text from scientific PDF papers, parsing section trees and figures, building a searchable corpus across many papers, or pulling lead sentences for rapid paper triage. Converts PDFs to TEI XML via a local GROBID service and parses titles, authors, abstracts, keywords, sections, figures and references into JSON, Markdown or HTML. 用于 PDF 全文抽取与语料检索。
protein-docking-lightdock: Use when protein-protein docking must be performed on the local machine, when a swarm-level score ranking is needed, or when the best docked complex model must be generated as a PDB file. Runs lightdock3 locally and extracts the best complex with correct GSO field semantics, numeric step selection, and a single consistent coordinate frame; supports batch grids, resumable execution and DFIRE ranking. 用于本地 LightDock 对接。
